bootstrap.scope: Paired path bootstrap stratified by observed job, with joint control-count resampling shared across noise factors. No second resampling of evolution shots. Pointwise descriptive intervals, not simultaneous; drift and calibration-model bias excluded.

current_readout_correction: Same marginal zero/one affine SPAM model extended to pairs assuming local product response. Not a correlated-readout inverse; basis-rotation and evolution errors are not removed. No clipping or target fitting.
